items.name: Google DeepMind Genie 4
items.summary: Google DeepMind's Genie 4, announced October 27, is a world model that generates interactive, photorealistic simulated environments in real time, with native audio — music, ambient sound and character dialogue — generated alongside the scene. Users steer it with keyboard controls and natural-language prompts; it is rolling out first as a research preview for trusted testers, then to Google AI Ultra subscribers in Project Genie.

items.name: Liquid AI LFM3
items.summary: Liquid AI's LFM3, released October 27, is a family of six open-weight models in the 2-billion-parameter class — text, vision, audio, omni and two decision variants — all branched from one 1.7B base pre-trained on 22 trillion tokens. The text model has a 256K-token context and fits in about 1 GB at 4-bit precision, targeting on-device and edge deployment.

items.name: OpenAI GPT-6.1 Terra
items.summary: OpenAI's fast everyday-work model, launched October 26, combines visual reasoning with precise computer use and clearer writing at 50% lower standard API prices than GPT-5.6 Terra and GPT-6.1 Sol. It is available in ChatGPT Work and Codex and via the API as gpt-6.1-terra, and OpenAI says it finishes tasks over 3x faster than GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol.

items.name: vLLM Semantic Router d3-ultra
items.summary: vLLM Semantic Router's d3-ultra, opened October 26, is a 26-billion-parameter open (Apache-2.0) multimodal decision model that returns structured answers — choices, yes/no judgements and scores — for text, JSON, images and video instead of open-ended text. It is built for routing, ranking and evaluation inside larger AI systems, with a free API and self-hosting via Hugging Face.

items.name: OpenMobile-2
items.summary: OpenMobile-2, an open smartphone agent from researchers at Nanjing University, SenseTime and partner institutions, posted 79.9 on the AndroidWorld benchmark in results reported October 26, ahead of Google's Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview at 70.7. The 27-billion-parameter model, built on Qwen3.6-27B, is aimed at agents that operate phone apps through their screens.
